# Medicine Brand Finder

> Find the brand names of a medicine's active ingredient (or of a brand name) in other countries. Results come from official medicines databases (EU and 39 countries: EU EMA, France, Italy, Poland, Netherlands, Ireland, Switzerland, Czech Republic, Denmark, Sweden, Finland, Lithuania, Ukraine, Malta, Canada, United States, Colombia, Taiwan, Singapore, New Zealand, Spain, and through EMA's Article 57 data Austria, Belgium, Bulgaria, Croatia, Cyprus, Estonia, Germany, Greece, Hungary, Iceland, Latvia, Liechtenstein, Luxembourg, Norway, Portugal, Romania, Slovakia, Slovenia and the United Kingdom (Northern Ireland)), open references (RxNorm, openFDA, Wikidata, PubChem) and optional AI suggestions; every result is labelled with its source. Demo, not medical advice. Free software, GPL-3.0-or-later.

- Live: https://medicine-finder.up.railway.app/
- Source: https://github.com/andreibesleaga/medicine-finder
- Result types: official (regulator data), reference (open reference data), curated (static sample lists, not from a regulator), ai (model suggestion, unverified).

## API

- [API reference](https://github.com/andreibesleaga/medicine-finder/blob/main/docs/API.md): GET /api/search?q=<ingredient or brand>&country=<country> (official data; a brand name is answered with its ingredient's brands and a `brand` field), GET /api/ai (AI suggestions), GET /api/sources (source status), GET /api/health. JSON, rate-limited, no key needed.

- Results page: shareable address /?q=<term>&country=<country>&lang=<language>; each result list downloads as CSV, XLSX, JSON or HL7 FHIR R4 (Medication + Provenance, RxNorm-coded ingredients) with the source and its terms on every row. Interface in 20 languages.

- [Architecture](https://github.com/andreibesleaga/medicine-finder/blob/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): components, search flow, ranking, country fallbacks, datasets, limits; code map at the end
- [Deploy](https://github.com/andreibesleaga/medicine-finder/blob/main/docs/DEPLOY.md): Railway (default), Vercel switch, variables, local and Docker
- [Data sources](https://github.com/andreibesleaga/medicine-finder/blob/main/docs/DATA-SOURCES.md): registers in use and every other national register checked, with access and licence
- [Notices](https://github.com/andreibesleaga/medicine-finder/blob/main/NOTICE.md): data-source terms and attributions
- [Contributing](https://github.com/andreibesleaga/medicine-finder/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): rules, adding a data source
